questions.prompt: According to your notes, what was the lunar module named?

evidence.quote: The command module, named Columbia, carried the crew to the Moon
The lunar module, named Eagle, carried two astronauts
on July 16, 1969, on a Saturn V rocket

questions.explanation: Eagle was the lunar module; Columbia was the command module and Saturn V was the rocket.

questions.prompt: According to your notes, put the stages of the mission in order.
steps: The Saturn V launches the crew and sends them towards the Moon
The spacecraft enters orbit around the Moon
The lunar module separates and lands in the Sea of Tranquility
The lunar module lifts off and docks with the command module
The command module splashes down in the Pacific Ocean

evidence.quote: First, the Saturn V launched the crew into Earth orbit
Finally, Columbia returned to Earth and splashed down in the Pacific Ocean

questions.explanation: Paragraph 5 lists the stages with first, next, then, after, finally.
